verdict.rationale: Airweave ingests documents and files indirectly. It syncs from connected sources such as cloud drives, Google Drive, Airtable attachments and Bitbucket code files, then makes that content searchable, and its agentic search can read full documents. Nothing shows a developer can directly store an image or PDF as a memory input. Missing for 10: direct file/image/PDF upload as memory, documented PDF and image parsing/OCR, multimodal recall evidence, and hands-on corroboration.
